This is the third island in the Tutorial Campaign

Here the player liberates enough fuel from the refinery to allow them to proceed with the campaign. Also, he gets a Manta into the Carrier arsenal.

= Tutorial =
*Hacking a Building complex
*Difficult terrain
*Manta

= Achievement =
For skipping the objective '''(#3)''' and overpowering the defenses of the Command center complex by conventional means, an achievement is awarded.

= Objectives =
#LIQUID TREASURE
#*Treasure is an island rich in raw materials, namely unrefined fuel. These resources will definitely come in handy. We need to take the island and make uses of its riches.
#HACK THE COMMAND CENTER
#*Once we hack the Command Center, the island is ours.
#DEACTIVATE THE ISLAND'S DEFENSES
#*If both parabolas are aimed at the Command Center, the resulting feedback loop should disable the island&apos;s defenses for a while.
#SEARCH THE REFINERY
#*This island is used for refining fuel for use in vehicles and ships. Perhaps the Refinery will have fuel for our Carrier, which we really need to continue north.

= Hints =
'''The parabolas''' need '''not''' to be activated in the same time or in any specified order. In doing task '''(#3)''', I suggest activating the more remote parabola, one near the refinery, first.
